# HexPiece 3.9.7

The Itsumade's kit, part 2 (from your spec), and the islands' rivers. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and every test suite pass,
and every new pose (the gust's flap, the talons carrying, the jaws gathering and pouring) was rendered and checked off-game. The
fire of the beam and the lightning are drawn in game only (they are not in the off-game renders).

## The passive
- **Only Ryou kills an Itsumade eater.** Any other death is undone: you burst into black smoke and stand again on safe ground 10 blocks
  away (solid under your feet, room to stand, no water or lava), with full health and full energy. (The void and /kill still kill.)
- **Your Haki wears the Itsumade's colours** (your Haki_Color reference): every lightning of yours (Ryou, the Conqueror's) a deep
  blue-indigo, its glow a sick green, whatever colour you chose; your own comes back if you lose the fruit.
- **Your Conqueror's release (G) kills now**: it is never spared; it takes most of what is left and more on top (a full release kills).

## In its form
- **M1 Wind Gust** (slow): it rears up, raises its wings high, and brings them down in one huge flap; everything in the cone in front of
  you (50 degrees either side, 24 blocks) is thrown far back, harder the nearer; dust and air sweep out over the cone.
- **M2 Talons** (flying): the talons close on whatever is under you and carry it wherever you fly, for as long as you like; M2 again (or
  landing) lets it go. Its legs reach down with the talons clenched while it carries.
- **X Bow**: for 15 seconds the Conqueror's lightning tears off its body, every bolt leaving from a point of its skin (never from inside
  it), striking and stunning whatever is near (up to 16 blocks), or the ground round it.
- **C Enormous Bite**: the neck lunges and the jaws snap shut where you look: heavy damage, bleeding, broken bones (the Gura fruit's).
- **V Yokai Beam** (hold): a ball of white-hot fire gathers in the opening jaws, black flames licking round it, bigger the longer you
  hold; let go and it pours out of the jaws as a beam of orange fire with a white-hot heart, wrapped in rolling black flames (40 to 100
  blocks, 1.5 to 5 seconds), burning through what it meets and exploding at its end in a great ball of fire.

## The islands
- **Narrower rivers**: they were 35 to 56 blocks wide and cut the smaller islands to pieces; now 17 to 28 blocks, still wide enough for
  a boat, every river still running coast to coast. Checked on the real terrain (the game's own density functions), seed 2: about 4% of
  the world is land, every island ringed by its beach and a shallow shelf, the sea floor deep. A new world is needed to see it.

## Still to come
- Untransformed: X Gorosei Stare, C Enormous Presence, V Yokai Blast, B Thy Death, N Hellish Teleport (the menu and the pentagrams).
